title: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 6: Don't Die

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A former planeswalker from Theros bound by the cult, who frees the others and is saved from a fatal knife by a fateshifter.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A nezumi child who confronts his mother's scroll echo, frees her at her request, and returns to Kamigawa.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: The sparkless Emperor of Kamigawa who duels Valgavoth with a glowing sword and gives Nashi a fateshifter.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A survivor who admits he sacrificed his best friend to Valgavoth for his heart's desire, and is taken by Valgavoth.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: A giant moth-demon who is the heart of the House, offers Winter freedom, battles the heroes, and is stabbed by Kaito.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Nashi's mother, present as a scroll echo trapped in a ghost-trap who asks to be released.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: An elf prince who arrives laughing, brawls with the cultists and helps carry Zimone out.

entities.name: Zimone Wola
entities.description: A Quandrix student who, transformed into a splintered wood figure, frees Niko and uses Niv-Mizzet's math box as a weapon.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who returns through an artificial Omenpath and stabs Valgavoth.

entities.name: Proft
entities.description: A researcher whose mind magic holds the artificial Omenpath open and who is visited by a door at the end.

entities.name: Aminatou
entities.description: The fate-twisting girl who contributed to the artificial Omenpath.

entities.name: Madame Etrata
entities.description: A colleague of Proft freed to normal duties.

entities.name: Yoshimaru
entities.description: The Wanderer's dog, reunited with her on Kamigawa.

entities.name: Marina
entities.description: The girl who first answered Valgavoth's call with a sacrifice.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon whose box Zimone carries.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: Robed worshippers of Valgavoth led by a soft-spoken head cultist who hold the heroes captive.

entities.name: Reckoners
entities.description: Nashi's friends from home who came with him and were lost.

entities.name: Cellarspawn
entities.description: Monsters that spill from the walls when Valgavoth roars.

entities.name: Nightmares
entities.description: Fear-fed monsters that pour out with the cellarspawn.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The demon house-plane that is Valgavoth's body.

entities.name: Fateshifters
entities.description: Tokens of Aminatou's power that rewind a fatal choice.

entities.name: Artificial Omenpath
entities.description: A temporary doorway made from Kaito's spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate magic and a piece of the House, leading from the House to Ravnica.

entities.name: Ghost-trap
entities.description: A box the cult uses to hold Tamiyo's scroll echo and harvest her stories.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The home plane of Nashi, the Wanderer and Kaito.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane to which the team escapes.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university where Zimone and the others go after the rescue.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Niko's home plane.

events.summary: Niko wakes bound to a chair with the Wanderer and Nashi in a cult chamber hung with chrysalises.
events.quote: They still couldn't move their hands or feet.

events.summary: Niko feels betrayed by Winter, their only ally in the House.
events.quote: they had been betrayed by their only ally inside the House

events.summary: Nashi blames himself for leading his Reckoner friends to their deaths.
events.quote: I came in here with four of the Reckoners I knew from back home.

events.summary: The head cultist appears and recites the cult's blessing.
events.quote: the head cultist walked between them and the Wanderer, still carrying his book.

events.summary: The head cultist says the captives' knowledge of other worlds will guide the Devouring Father to his next feast.
events.quote: Your knowledge will be added to the great list, and with it we will guide the Devouring Father to his next feasting place.

events.summary: Cultists open a box and Tamiyo's shade appears; Nashi calls to her but she turns away.
events.quote: When they put it down, the top snapped open, and Tamiyo's shade appeared.

events.summary: The head cultist promises Nashi the gift of rebirth in a cocoon.
events.quote: His cocoon has been prepared, and he will live eternally in the Devouring Father's service.

events.summary: Valgavoth reveals himself as an enormous moth-demon melded into the wall and the cultists kneel.
events.quote: what appeared to be an enormous moth spun from the fabric of nightmares

events.summary: Valgavoth tells Winter he promised his heart's desire in exchange for four lives.
events.quote: Four lives to secure your heart's desire. Four thresholds for me to cross.

events.summary: Niko deduces that Winter sacrificed his best friend to Valgavoth.
events.quote: You sacrificed her to a monster for your own heart's desire.

events.summary: Winter says he gave everything and asks to be let go.
events.quote: I gave everything. Now let me go.

events.summary: Valgavoth opens a door in his body and promises Winter he may leave; Winter falls as he runs.
events.quote: When he folded them again, there was a door set in the base of his body

events.summary: Tyvar bursts in with a brawl, tossing cultists across the room.
events.quote: Bad form, to start the battle without us!

events.summary: Zimone, transformed into a splintered-wood figure, cuts Niko free.
events.quote: its voice was Zimone's, and the figure was Zimone, somehow transformed like the wickerfolk

events.summary: Niko frees the Wanderer who retrieves her sword.
events.quote: They sliced through the ropes holding her arms and legs to the chair

events.summary: The Wanderer frees Nashi and gives him a small object, saying he can change his fate.
events.quote: You can change your fate

events.summary: Niko seals Winter in a shard as he tries the door a third time.
events.quote: one of Niko's shards to hit him squarely in the back and envelop him, sealing him away from the freedom he'd so craved

events.summary: Zimone uses Niv-Mizzet's box to trap a cultist in a cascade of geometric light.
events.quote: The box immediately spilled a geometric cascade of blue and green lines into the air.

events.summary: The Wanderer leaps onto the altar and duels the giant moth.
events.quote: The Wanderer had leapt up onto the stone altar, and was dueling the massive demon moth

events.summary: Tamiyo tells Nashi the cult has been stealing her stories and she cannot be saved.
events.quote: They've been stealing my stories, Nashi

events.summary: Tamiyo asks Nashi to let her go.
events.quote: Let me go.

events.summary: Valgavoth roars and cellarspawn and nightmares pour out of the walls.
events.quote: cellarspawn and nightmares spilled out of them, pouring into the room.

events.summary: The door Niko reaches for crumbles to dust.
events.quote: the door was gone, falling to dust under Niko's fingers

events.summary: A cultist stabs Niko through the eye in a fateshifter vision.
events.quote: Niko felt the blade pierce their eye and continue through the thin barrier of their skull

events.summary: The fateshifter rewinds the moment and Niko dodges and captures the cultist.
events.quote: The world snapped like a tightened bowstring, and Niko was looking up at Valgavoth.

events.summary: Valgavoth pins the Wanderer and threatens to unmake her world.
events.quote: I will swallow everything you are, and I will unmake your world in my own image

events.summary: Nashi pulls his mother's scroll from the ghost-trap, and Tamiyo dissolves into moonlight.
events.quote: before she dissolved into moonlight and was gone.

events.summary: Kaito stabs Valgavoth in the chest through the wall with his katana.
events.quote: The blade of a katana protruded from it, glistening with ichor and hemolymph

events.summary: Kaito stands before a blue-white door of light, an artificial Omenpath.
events.quote: Behind him on the wall was a door formed from blue-white light

events.summary: The team escapes through the door, with Kaito covering Tyvar against a nightmare.
events.quote: Together they ran for the door.

events.summary: Kaito explains the artificial Omenpath is made of his spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting and a piece of the House.
events.quote: My spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting, and a piece of the House that I took with me when I had to planeswalk away.

events.summary: Nashi says goodbye to his mother's empty scroll and leaves it behind.
events.quote: I hope you can rest now.

events.summary: The team steps out onto Ravnica.
events.quote: stepping with them out into the light of the Ravnican afternoon.

events.summary: Proft closes the door in a spray of moths of light.
events.quote: he made a sharp gesture and the door slammed shut, vanishing in a spray of white light shaped like tiny, glittering moths.

events.summary: Wounded Valgavoth survives and pulls a captive orange-furred creature from the attic.
events.quote: He reached into the attic above him, wrapping a tendril around a squirming, shivering bundle of orange fur and pulling it down into view.

events.summary: Valgavoth takes Winter and melts into the ceiling with him.
events.quote: Pulling Winter higher to his leaking, punctured chest, Valgavoth melted into the ceiling

events.summary: Back on Kamigawa, Nashi tells children the story of their adventure.
events.quote: watching as Nashi spun the story of their adventures to a crowd of rapt youngsters.

events.summary: Zimone, Tyvar and Niko go to Strixhaven.
events.quote: The others had gone with Zimone back to Strixhaven

events.summary: A door engraved with moths forms in Proft's mental office.
events.quote: the shape of a doorframe slowly appearing out of the shelves and photographs.

relations.quote: The cultists dropped to their knees, all of them, bending to press their foreheads to the floor.

relations.note: Struck a bargain with Winter for four sacrifices in exchange for freedom.
relations.quote: I promised you your heart's desire

relations.note: Made a similar promise to Marina years ago.
relations.quote: I promised you what I promised my Marina, so many years ago
The blade of a katana protruded from it

relations.note: His mother, who calls him her sweetest boy.
relations.quote: Oh, my sweetest boy, there are stories whose endings can be changed, and those that can't.

relations.note: They hold her in a ghost-trap and steal her stories.
relations.quote: The people who took me have me connected to this ghost-trap to keep me here

relations.note: Contributes mind magic to the artificial Omenpath.
relations.quote: My spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting

relations.note: Guards his back in the fight.
relations.quote: Zimone followed close behind him, guarding his back with her magic and machine.

relations.note: Niko seals Winter in a shard after learning of his betrayal.
relations.quote: one of Niko's shards to hit him squarely in the back and envelop him
